places.name: Delphi Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Delphi was considered the center of the world in ancient Greek mythology and features the Temple of Apollo.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water for exploring the ruins.

places.name: Delphi Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing artifacts from the Delphi Archaeological Site, including the famous Charioteer of Delphi statue.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Charioteer statue and other ancient artifacts.

places.name: Thermopylae Battlefield
places.ai_summary: The historic site of the famous battle between the Spartans and Persians, featuring a monument to King Leonidas.
places.place_tip: Visit the monument and learn about the battle’s history.

places.name: Mount Parnassus National Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning national park offering hiking, skiing, and breathtaking views, home to the legendary Mount Parnassus.
places.place_tip: Explore the hiking trails and enjoy the panoramic views.
places.address: Mount Parnassus National Park, Delphi, Greece

places.name: Arachova Village
places.ai_summary: A picturesque mountain village known for its traditional architecture, vibrant nightlife, and proximity to ski resorts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for nightlife.

places.place_tip: Try the local cuisine and enjoy the mountain views.

attribution.title: Arahova
attribution.author: Peter von Hess
attribution.description: The Battle of Arachova, painting by Peter von Hess

places.name: Karpenisi Ski Center
places.ai_summary: A popular ski resort in Central Greece, offering excellent slopes for skiing and snowboarding.
places.place_tip: Book ski passes in advance and rent equipment in the village.

places.name: Hosios Loukas Monastery
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, this Byzantine monastery is famous for its stunning mosaics and beautiful mountain setting.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Wednesdays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Respect the dress code and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

places.name: Galaxidi Town
places.ai_summary: A charming coastal town with traditional Greek architecture, beautiful beaches, and a picturesque harbor.
places.place_tip: Enjoy fresh seafood by the harbor and explore the old town.

places.name: Amfissa Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic castle offering panoramic views of the surrounding area, including the Gulf of Corinth.
places.place_tip: Visit the castle museum and enjoy the views from the top.

places.name: Lake Yliki
places.ai_summary: A beautiful lake ideal for fishing, hiking, and picnicking, located near the town of Livadeia.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the spring and summer.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy a day by the water.

places.name: Chaironeia Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: An important archaeological site with ruins of ancient buildings and a famous lion monument.
places.place_tip: See the Lion of Chaironeia and explore the ancient ruins.

places.name: Orchomenus Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: The site of the ancient city of Orchomenus, featuring well-preserved ruins and a museum.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum and see the ancient theater ruins.

places.name: Livadeia (Springs of Krya)
places.ai_summary: A scenic area with natural springs, ideal for a relaxing day in nature.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the beautiful scenery.

places.name: Lamia Castle
places.ai_summary: A medieval castle offering guided tours and stunning views of the surrounding region.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the castle's history.

places.name: Gorgopotamos Bridge
places.ai_summary: A historic bridge with stunning views, famous for its role in World War II.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Walk across the bridge and enjoy the views of the gorge.

attribution.description: The rail bridge at Gorgopotamos that was blown up by the resistance during WWII

places.name: Athanasios Diakos Monument
places.ai_summary: A monument dedicated to the Greek hero Athanasios Diakos, located in the town of Lamia.
places.place_tip: Learn about the history of Athanasios Diakos and the Greek War of Independence.

places.name: Monastery of Panagia Prousiotissa
places.ai_summary: A beautiful monastery located on the slopes of Mount Parnassus, known for its stunning views and peaceful atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the tranquility and take in the breathtaking views.
places.address: Monastery of Panagia Prousiotissa, Delphi, Greece

places.name: Mount Giona
places.ai_summary: The highest mountain in Central Greece, offering challenging hikes and stunning views from the summit.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the spring and fall.

places.place_tip: Start early and be prepared for a strenuous hike.

places.name: Euboea Island (Chalkida, Beaches)
places.ai_summary: A nearby island known for its beautiful beaches, charming towns, and the unique Chalkida Canal.
places.place_tip: Explore the beaches and try local seafood dishes.

places.name: Oiti National Park
places.ai_summary: A national park with rich biodiversity, offering hiking trails and stunning views of the Oiti Mountain.
places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks for the hike.
places.address: Oiti National Park, Central Greece, Greece
